sv.title: Fick maxdos av adhd-medicin – ett år senare planerade hon självmord
sv.summary: Jasmine fick diagnosen adhd efter att ha utretts av onlinekliniken Psykiatrispecialisterna. Hon fick maxdos av medicin – ett år senare planerade hon sitt självmord. – Jag fick veta att det finns muntorrhet. Huvudvärk. Problem med sömn. Det var det jag fick veta, inget annat.

en.title: Given max dose of ADHD medication – a year later she planned suicide
en.summary: Jasmine was diagnosed with ADHD after being assessed by the online clinic Psykiatrispecialisterna. She was given a maximum dose of medication, and a year later she planned her suicide. “I was told there is dry mouth. Headache. Problems with sleep. That's what I was told, nothing else.”
